title: bn254-gt-dlp: SexTNFS discrete logarithm, conservative ledger 2^111.705913

claims.statement: For the full protected BN254 target group GT (order-r subgroup of F_{p^12}^*, r and p 254-bit, x=0x44e992b44a6909f1) and uniform z=g^a, the SexTNFS discrete-logarithm attack of proof.md recovers a with g^a=z using total classical work at most 2^111.705913 reference units (20,000 scalar AArch64 instruction equivalents per unit, C=20,000), with exploratory success probability at least 0.39 over uniform production challenges and fresh coins, and peak storage at most 2^66 bytes. The attack is a Special extended Tower Number Field Sieve in F_{p^12} using a coprime (eta,kappa)=(4,3) tower (base field F_{p^4} via an irreducible degree-4 h, Joux-Pierrot special side f=P(X^kappa+S) of small coefficients), followed by per-target special-q individual-logarithm descent of both g and z. The first-order complexity is L_Q[1/3,(32/9)^{1/3}]=2^109.69. Concrete balanced-optimum chain: smoothness bound B=2^54.85, smoothness parameter u=14.3, rho(u)=1.4e-18; relation collection 2^109.69; block-Wiedemann/Lanczos linear algebra over Z/r with matrix dimension D=2^49.6 costing 2^106.20 (sub-dominant); special-q descent 2^104. Each NFS operation is charged conservatively as at most one dense-Fp12 reference unit, removing per-kernel instruction dependence. The chain sums to 2^109.84; the claim adds a disclosed 1.87-bit aggregate margin (filtering, Schirokauer maps, setup, the L-constant o(1), amplification). Total work includes all preprocessing, relation collection, filtering, linear algebra, descent, verification and output, with no amortization over future targets and no free oracles or advice. Success >= 0.39 holds for any per-log descent-boot failure up to 0.30 (modelled 2e-3). The first-order constant relies on the disclosed NFS heuristics H1-H5 of proof.md section 8; independent concrete estimates for this field are near 2^100, ~11 bits below the claim, so the claim is a conservative over-estimate, not a premise. Analytic exploratory claim, not a production-scale execution.

experiments.purpose: Deterministically recompute, from the public BN254 parameter x, the p/r/Q bit-sizes, the SexTNFS and generic-exTNFS first-order bit-costs, the smoothness bound B, parameter u, Dickman rho(u) and norm size, the matrix dimension D, the three ledger terms and their sum, the disclosed margin, the claimed rational and the memory bound; and construct a concrete degree-4 polynomial h and verify it is irreducible mod p (genuine evidence that the eta=4 base field is realisable). It checks internal consistency of the chain and claim; it does not execute, simulate, or prove a production-scale number field sieve.
